subject: Onsite edge IaC security evidence & network templates
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: GreenGrid Systems <ops@greengridsys.com>
Cc: procurement@greengridsys.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite edge IaC security evidence & network templates

Hi Alex / GreenGrid team,

Thanks again for hosting our on-site review next week. To keep the meeting focused, attached are the initial IaC artifacts and a short evidence checklist we’d like you to validate ahead of the session: edge-network-acl.tf (sample Terraform), onprem-ansible-playbook.yml (bootstrap playbook), and iac-evidence-checklist.pdf.

Top asks before we arrive: 
- Confirm whether the ACL template maps to your existing edge firewall rules (a yes/no plus screenshots of the management console is fine).
- Share any additional CI gates you run for Helm values or Argo CD preflight checks.
- If you have an internal audit owner, please provide a single point-of-contact and preferred evidence format (PDF / signed spreadsheet / S3 link).

We’ll use the onsite time to walk network segmentation, egress controls, and the drill for secret/credential injection validation. Karthik (cc’d) will run through the CI gating checklist with your engineers.

Appreciate a quick confirm and an ETA on the screenshots by EOD Wednesday so we can adjust the agenda.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: edge-network-acl.tf (Terraform), onprem-ansible-playbook.yml (YAML), iac-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: GreenGrid Systems <ops@greengridsys.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greengridsys.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite edge IaC security evidence & network templates

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — we got the artifacts. Couple of quick clarifying questions before we generate screenshots: 
1) In edge-network-acl.tf, the sample uses a multi-vlan security-group model. Our edge equipment is ACL-based on the hardware (no security groups). Will the provided TF be an exact import or a mapping sheet is acceptable?
2) For CI gates, we run a custom preflight in Jenkins + a policy check in OPA; do you want the Jenkins job logs or the OPA policy bundle outputs?
3) Who should the screenshots be addressed to for the audit pass-through? Procurement or your security team?

We can have a small packet ready by Wednesday but need to confirm the above.

—Alex (GreenGrid Ops)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: GreenGrid Systems <ops@greengridsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite edge IaC security evidence & network templates

Alex — thanks, good questions. Answers below and next steps.

1) Mapping vs import: Mapping sheet is fine. Please include the hardware ACL entry and the equivalent intent in the TF sample (short table). We do not need an exact Terraform import — just a clear mapping so our reviewers can trace intent to enforcement.

2) CI evidence: We prefer the OPA policy bundle outputs (policy evaluation logs) plus a Jenkins job link for traceability. If the policy bundle is large, a gzipped export stored in S3 or a Drive folder link is fine.

3) Screenshot recipient: Please address the artifacts to "Redwood Security <security-evidence@redwood.com>" and cc procurement for contract traceability.

Karthik / Mina — could you review sections 3 and 4 of the checklist (CI gating + secrets handling) and call out any additional items we should ask for?

Thanks,
Lauren

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: GreenGrid Systems <ops@greengridsys.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite edge IaC security evidence & network templates

Alex — quick technical note from the CI gating perspective: 

Thanks for confirming the OPA + Jenkins combo — that’s what we expected. For the evidence packet, please include the following minimal artifacts (these are what our automation and auditors will check):
- OPA evaluation output for the last successful run (JSON) for the policy bundle that gated the helm values and terraform plan.
- Jenkins job console text + artifact link (we don’t need full logs; truncation is fine as long as it contains the preflight result and timestamp).
- The terraform plan (terraform plan -out=plan.binary) translated into a human readable diff (plan show) or a short snippet showing the ACL creation blocks.
- Secret handling: show the KMS/hsm key id used and the vault path; redact actual secrets.

One ask on templates: if you can produce a short CSV mapping hardware-ACL -> tf-intent, that speeds review a lot. I’ll bring a small script to reconcile names during the onsite.

Also tagging Mina — can you confirm the minimum retention window we require for these artifacts (we usually ask for 90 days) so procurement is aware?

-Karthik

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: GreenGrid Systems <ops@greengridsys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite edge IaC security evidence & network templates

Alex / procurement — thanks for moving quickly. Confirming Redwood minimums: 
- Evidence retention: 90 days for CI artifacts and policy outputs; 365 days for audit logs if available.
- Format: OPA JSON + Jenkins URL (or gzipped console text) + PDF screenshots for hardware ACLs.
- Delivery: please drop files into the Drive folder linked here (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-edge-iac) and email security-evidence@redwood.com when done.

If you can upload by EOD Wednesday (May 6 PST) we’ll finalize the onsite agenda and remove the network deep-dive if everything looks good. If you need an extension, let us know by EOD Tuesday and we’ll adjust.

Appreciate the help — see you next week.

Mina Haddad
Principal, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced earlier: edge-network-acl.tf, onprem-ansible-playbook.yml, iac-evidence-checklist.pdf
